mapper.select: SELECT uv_index AS uvIndex, dust_index AS dustIndex, exposure_rate AS exposureRate, max_uv_today AS maxUvToday FROM DAILY_UV_STATUS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_date = CURDATE()
SELECT dr.skin_type FROM SKINMON s JOIN DIAGNOSIS_RESULT dr ON s.result_id = dr.result_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DAILY_UV_STATUS (user_id, target_date, uv_index, exposure_rate, max_uv_today) VALUES (#{userId}, CURDATE(), #{uvIndex}, #{exposureRate}, #{maxUvToday}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE uv_index = VALUES(uv_index), exposure_rate = VALUES(exposure_rate), max_uv_today = VALUES(max_uv_today)
